frostrail-release-date.title: Frostrail Release Date
frostrail-release-date.lede: Frostrail is planned to enter Steam Early Access in Q4 2026. FakeFish and Shiro Unlimited have not announced an exact release day or price.
frostrail-release-date.imageAlt: Official Frostrail key art with survivors and the armored steam train

sections.title: Current release window
paragraphs: The official Steam store lists a Q4 2026 Early Access window. A specific day has not been announced, so December 31 dates on generic listings should be read as placeholders, not a launch announcement. Lead designer Ez Jämsen said in the July 2026 Closed Beta press kit that the team was heading into the final stages of development and that Frostrail had gained almost 500,000 Steam wishlists since reveal.

sections.title: Early Access plans
paragraphs: FakeFish expects Early Access to last approximately one year. The starting version is planned around the core gameplay loop, while the full version is expected to add more biomes, locations, dungeons, loot, weapons, train upgrades, and co-op situations.
bullets: Core loop first
More content and systems planned through Early Access
Timing and scope can change during development

sections.title: Closed Beta before Early Access
paragraphs: The next confirmed test milestone is a closed beta beginning August 31, 2026. It follows the April 16–May 4 closed playtest, which focused on the early gameplay loop. A beta date is not the Early Access release date.

sections.title: Is Frostrail free, and how much will it cost?
paragraphs: Frostrail has not been announced as a free-to-play game, and no price is public. The Early Access statement says the price may increase when the game reaches version 1.0, depending on how much content is added.

sections.title: What the full version is planned to add
paragraphs: The official Early Access statement describes the launch version as a stable foundation and the full version as a deeper game with more biomes, unique locations, dungeons, varied loot, craftable items and weapons, train upgrades, and co-op situations. These are development goals rather than a dated delivery roadmap.
bullets: More biomes and locations
More dungeons and varied loot
More item, weapon, and train progression
More co-op scenarios
Polish, balance, performance, and bug fixes

frostrail-system-requirements.title: Frostrail System Requirements
frostrail-system-requirements.lede: The Steam PC listing requires a 64-bit processor and operating system, but FakeFish has not yet published a minimum or recommended OS version, CPU, GPU, memory, storage, or sound specification.
frostrail-system-requirements.imageAlt: Official Frostrail gameplay screenshot from inside the train cab

sections.title: Minimum requirements
paragraphs: Steam currently requires a 64-bit processor and operating system. It does not yet name a Windows version, processor, memory target, graphics card, storage amount, or sound device.

sections.title: Recommended requirements
paragraphs: The recommended specification is also unpublished. Estimates based on other Unreal Engine 5 games cannot tell you whether Frostrail will run well on a particular PC.

sections.title: Engine & performance status
paragraphs: Frostrail runs on Unreal Engine 5. After the November 2025 playtest, the team identified performance, AI, usability, accessibility, and tutorials as areas that still needed work. The lower-fidelity art direction shown in the February 2026 gameplay trailer is also intended to make performance and content production more manageable.
bullets: Engine: Unreal Engine 5
PC and Steam are the launch priority
Performance remains an active development area
Frame-rate targets, upscalers, graphics presets, and accessibility settings have not been detailed

sections.title: Current language support
paragraphs: Steam currently lists interface and subtitle support for English, French, German, Spanish (Spain), Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, and Simplified Chinese. No full-audio language is listed. Official Closed Beta and gameplay-trailer press kits also name Polish as planned Early Access support; that language is not on the live store list as of this verification date.
facts: Press-kit plan / not on live Steam list

frostrail-multiplayer.title: Frostrail Multiplayer & Co-op
frostrail-multiplayer.lede: Frostrail supports single-player and online co-op for crews of one to four. Players share responsibility for expeditions and the Eden Engine rather than selecting announced fixed classes.
frostrail-multiplayer.imageAlt: Two Frostrail players defending a train carriage in online co-op
frostrail-multiplayer.status: Solo and online co-op for 1–4 players

sections.title: Player count & modes
paragraphs: Steam lists both single-player and online co-op, while the official FAQ states that crews contain one to four players. The game is designed so the train and expedition loop can be played solo or shared.

sections.title: Co-op gameplay
paragraphs: Crews operate, maintain, expand, and defend the Eden Engine, then explore frozen levels for materials, equipment, and Relics. Founder Aku Jauhiainen says co-op is designed so players can divide tasks such as scavenging and defending the train. Public information does not announce class locks, so crew roles should be treated as situational responsibilities. Official gameplay-trailer press copy also warns that the roar of the engine draws Revenants from the frozen wilds, which is a shared-noise risk rather than a solo-only threat.
bullets: Coordinate fuel, power, driving, repair, and train defense
Split scavenging and train-guard tasks
Share scarce ammunition and crafting resources
Choose between multiple level exits
Do not treat engine noise as a confirmed aggro radius value

sections.title: How multiplayer worked in the April playtest
paragraphs: The April closed playtest included multiplayer and Steam's Friend Invite feature: an accepted player could invite one Steam friend, who could then invite another. That was a test-access method, not a promise that the released game will use the same invitation or ownership system.

sections.title: Cross-play, matchmaking and servers
paragraphs: Cross-play, cross-progression, local co-op, split-screen, matchmaking, server hosting, save ownership, drop-in play, and voice chat have not been detailed yet.

frostrail-console.title: Is Frostrail Coming to Console?
frostrail-console.lede: Frostrail is coming to Windows PC through Steam first. No PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo, Android, or iOS version has been announced; console ports may be evaluated for version 1.0 and beyond.

sections.title: PS5, Xbox, Nintendo and mobile status
paragraphs: PC and Steam are the current focus. The team plans to evaluate console ports for version 1.0 and beyond, which is not the same as announcing a port. Android and iOS versions have not been mentioned.

sections.title: Controller support
paragraphs: Controller support is planned, but it may not be ready for the start of Early Access. A controller option on PC would not by itself confirm a console release.

sections.title: Linux & macOS
paragraphs: Linux support has been described as tentative. Neither Linux nor macOS is confirmed; Windows PC remains the priority.

sections.title: When should players expect a firm answer?
paragraphs: A port becomes real when FakeFish or Shiro Unlimited names the platform and release plan, or when a platform holder publishes a store page. Controller work, ratings-board entries, retailer placeholders, and copied release listings are not enough on their own.
bullets: A named platform
A developer, publisher, or platform-holder announcement
A release window or development commitment
No reliance on placeholder dates

about-frostrail.title: About Frostrail
about-frostrail.lede: Frostrail is a dieselpunk open-world survival-crafting FPS for one to four players, developed by FakeFish and published by Shiro Unlimited in Unreal Engine 5.
about-frostrail.imageAlt: Official Frostrail key art showing the train and Penitent Gardeners

sections.title: What kind of game is Frostrail?
paragraphs: Frostrail combines first-person combat, open-world survival crafting, exploration, base building, horror, inventory management, and resource management. Its defining base is an armored train called the Eden Engine.
bullets: Single-player and online co-op
Frozen level exploration
Craftable and modular firearms
Train operation, expansion, and defense
Cold, heat, food, clothing, Relics, and dungeons

sections.title: Setting & story premise
paragraphs: The former empire was frozen after its Emperor made a pact with the Void. Players are Penitent Gardeners traveling north aboard the Eden Engine, scavenging abandoned settlements, wreckage, ruins, bunkers, strongholds, and dungeons while fighting Revenants and eldritch horrors.
facts: Empire frozen by a Void-linked pact

sections.title: Developer & publisher
paragraphs: FakeFish is a Turku, Finland studio founded in 2014 by five university friends. Publisher press kits describe an independent studio of about 30 people whose first game, Barotrauma, has sold more than three million units since 2019. Many Frostrail developers previously worked on Barotrauma; a Gamescom founder interview said around 15 people were working on Frostrail at that time. Shiro Unlimited, the publishing label of Shiro Games, is the publisher. Steam lists support@shirogames.com.

sections.title: What the game is built around
paragraphs: Every part of a run comes back to five ideas: the moving train base, ranged combat, lethal cold, co-op, and turning scavenged materials into something useful. The Eden Engine is not scenery—it sets how far the crew can explore, what can be carried home, and whether the journey continues.
facts: Cold as a tether and lethal hazard

sections.title: World & progression structure
paragraphs: The journey moves north through separate levels. At the end of a level, the crew uses a tunnel to select the next route; the world becomes colder and harder farther north. Terrain is hand-made, while natural assets, selected point-of-interest placement, loot, and enemy spawns use procedural systems for replayability.
The May 2026 update says progression now carries between levels and that new levels can provide multiple exits.

sections.title: Languages, ratings & Steam features
paragraphs: The current Steam store lists interface and subtitles in English, French, German, Spanish (Spain), Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, and Simplified Chinese, with no full-audio language. Publisher press kits for the 2026 playtest and Closed Beta also name Polish for Early Access, although Polish is not yet on the live Steam language list.
Steam currently lists single-player, multiplayer, online co-op, achievements, and Family Sharing. The mature-content note mentions combat against wolves and humanoid creatures with blood splatters.

sections.title: How this wiki is written
paragraphs: Frostrail Wiki is an independent fan project, not a FakeFish or Shiro Unlimited website. Pages are written to answer player questions first, then show the date and links used to check details that may change during development.

The site does not claim hands-on experience with a build unless a page names the test and the experience actually took place. Store pages, game builds, development posts, screenshots, and named interviews are kept separate so planned features do not read like finished mechanics.
bullets: No invented damage, drop-rate, recipe, or performance values
Build-specific numbers keep their date or test context
Placeholder retailer dates are not treated as release dates
Substantial updates change the page date; cosmetic edits do not

sections.title: Corrections & contact
paragraphs: Frostrail is changing quickly, and a test build can make an older detail obsolete. If you spot a wrong date, mislabeled screenshot, broken link, or value that changed in a newer build, use the Contact Us link in the footer and include the page URL plus a screenshot or public announcement when possible.

frostrail-faq.title: Frostrail FAQ
frostrail-faq.lede: Straight answers on Frostrail's release, price, player count, Closed Beta, platforms, controller support, mods, Unreal Engine 5, and the team behind the game.
frostrail-faq.imageAlt: Official Frostrail key art used for the FAQ overview

sections.title: Is Frostrail multiplayer, and how many people can play?
paragraphs: Frostrail supports solo play and online co-op for crews of up to four. The group shares responsibility for exploring, scavenging, fighting, and keeping the Eden Engine running.

sections.title: What engine does Frostrail use, and will it support mods?
paragraphs: Frostrail is built in Unreal Engine 5. Full Barotrauma-style moddability is not planned, partly because of engine constraints, although the team may explore smaller-scale customization during development and Early Access.

sections.title: Is Frostrail made by the Barotrauma team?
paragraphs: Yes. Many FakeFish developers who worked on Barotrauma are part of the Frostrail team, alongside people hired for the new project. No shared universe or direct story connection between the two games has been announced.

sections.title: Is Frostrail free to play, and how much will it cost?
paragraphs: Frostrail has not been announced as free to play. The Early Access price will be shared closer to the Steam launch, and it may increase when the game reaches version 1.0.

sections.title: How do I join the Frostrail Closed Beta?
paragraphs: The next Closed Beta begins August 31, 2026. Sign-ups are handled through the Frostrail Steam page, and people who registered for an earlier test do not need to register again. Registration does not guarantee an invitation.

sections.title: Is Frostrail on PS5, Xbox, mobile, Linux or Mac?
paragraphs: Frostrail enters Early Access on Windows PC through Steam first. Console ports may be evaluated for version 1.0 and beyond, but no PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo, Android, or iOS version is announced. Linux is tentative, macOS is unconfirmed, and controller support may arrive after the start of Early Access.

sections.title: Who is developing and publishing Frostrail?
paragraphs: FakeFish is developing Frostrail in Turku, Finland. Shiro Unlimited, the publishing label of Shiro Games, is the publisher. Steam lists support@shirogames.com for game support.
